subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the little boy from the reference image <Image 1>: his face, hairstyle, build, clothes and any props must match <Image 1> exactly in every frame.
<Image 1> is the reference image establishing both the character and the scene; it is the identity and environment anchor and must be copied 100% — the boy and his sofa / living-room setting must remain exactly as in <Image 1> throughout.
<Audio 1> is a voice-timbre reference only: its actual content is NOT used; only the child's vocal tone, pitch and quality are borrowed to voice <Subject 1>'s line and laughter.

summary:
[Reference-based generation] <Subject 1>, the little boy from <Image 1>, sits on the sofa in the exact living-room of <Image 1> and speaks a funny "toxic chicken-soup" line directly to the camera in a deadpan, innocent tone, with a growing, barely-suppressed smile, then bursts into a big delighted laugh. Fixed camera, single continuous shot. The boy's voice uses the vocal timbre of <Audio 1> only.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity and scene locked to <Image 1>: face, hairstyle, build, clothes, the sofa and the living-room background must not drift in any frame.
<Image 1> (character & scene reference): fully_preserved - the boy and his environment are copied 100% as the visual anchor.
<Audio 1> (voice timbre): reference - only the voice timbre is borrowed for the line and the laugh; the audio content of <Audio 1> is ignored and replaced by the specified Chinese line and the laugh.

detailed_description:
The target video is in realistic, cinematic, photoreal live-action style with warm indoor natural lighting, shallow depth of field and visible film grain.
[Shot 1] A single continuous shot of approximately 8 seconds — ONE FIXED CAMERA, completely static and locked for the entire shot: no pan, no tilt, no dolly, no push-in, no zoom, no orbit, no handheld shake.
The little boy from <Image 1> sits on the same sofa in the same living room, facing the camera. Medium shot: his upper body and face clearly visible near center frame, the warm blurred living-room background behind him exactly as in <Image 1>, camera at eye level with him.

EXPRESSION ARC (a natural smile curve): The shot opens with him in a calm, slightly serious, innocent face. As he speaks the line, a smile begins to form and slowly grows — he visibly tries to keep a straight, deadpan face but keeps failing, the corners of his mouth twitching upward, a small smile breaking through as he reaches the punchline, until by the end he is beaming with a proud, mischievous, childlike grin that he can barely hold back. This restrained, growing smile is the heart of the comedy.

PERFORMANCE (the comedy comes from the contrast): He speaks directly to the camera in a brisk, confident, deadpan, innocent, matter-of-fact childlike tone, as if calmly sharing a simple piece of everyday wisdom — while the growing smile betrays his mischief. He delivers the Chinese line clearly at a snappy, slightly quick pace:
"珍惜你现在没钱的日子吧，因为你马上就会富起来了。"
His lips sync naturally to the words; the delivery is sharp, deadpan and quick, never slow or drawn-out, his voice staying innocent and bright even as he delivers the cutting line.

LAUGH (action beat): Immediately after he finishes, he stops holding back and breaks into a big, genuine, gleeful laugh — head tilted back slightly, eyes crinkling, shoulders shaking — as if the joke is too good to keep in, clearly proud of himself. It ends on a smug, satisfied little grin as he settles back.

Micro-motion throughout so he never freezes or looks like a still photo: gentle breathing, slow blinks, small head tilts, slight body sway, casual little hand gestures, the growing smile, then the big laugh and the final smug grin. He never turns away from the camera and stays in frame the whole time.
The face, hairstyle, clothes and the entire scene must remain 100% consistent with <Image 1> in every frame — no facial morphing, no identity drift, no scene changes, no outfit changes.

overall_soundscape:
The little boy's voice, using the vocal timbre of <Audio 1>, speaks the Chinese line in a clear, brisk, deadpan childlike tone; soft rustle of his clothes; a quiet warm room tone; then, right after the line, his big, genuine, gleeful laugh — warm and mischievous, with a kid's full open-mouthed joy — ending on a short, self-satisfied giggle.

non_diegetic_music:
A light, playful, slightly cheeky piano or ukulele background score — warm and comedic, subtle and understated — gently accenting the line as his smile grows, then turning brighter and more playful as he bursts into laughter, and ending on a soft comedic "sting" as he grins.
